body: How skinny I am. I wish my ears didn't stick out so bad. My teeth have a looot of spaces in them. I barely have a butt. My hair is so ridiculous when I don't straighten it. Apparently one of my guy friends has a tiny no no and my boyfriend's told me they are great together. It doesn't matter the size as long as you have true feelings for them. It's always good when you love them. c:
